
 ▐▛███▛█   Claude Code v2.1.326
▝▜██████▀  Opus 5.5 · API Usage Billing
 ▝▝   ▝▝   ~/work

▎ Auto mode is now Claude Code's default permission mode.
▎ Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically. Claude checks each tool call for risky actions and
▎ prompt injection before executing, runs the ones it assesses as lower-risk, and blocks the rest.
▎ https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes

   Select model
   Switch between Claude models. Your pick becomes the default for new sessions. For other or older models, use
   --model.

   ❯ 1. Default (recommended) ✔  Use the default model (currently Opus 5.5) · $4/$20 per Mtok
     2. Opus                     Opus 5.5 · Best for everyday, complex tasks · $4/$20 per Mtok
     3. Fable                    Fable 5.2 · Most capable for your hardest and longest-running tasks · $8/$40 per
                                 Mtok
     4. Sonnet                   Sonnet 5.5 · Efficient for routine tasks · $2/$10 per Mtok
     5. Haiku                    Haiku 5.5 · Fastest for quick answers · $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for
                                 prompts over 100k)

   ◐ Medium effort (default) ←/→ to adjust

   Enter to set as default · s to use this session only · Esc to cancel
